mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing moderate drizzle at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 66 degrees. Also, get ready to look up tonight because the International Space Station will be visible starting at 7:40 PM, rising from the northwest near Verona High School and heading toward the northeast near Home Depot for five minutes.

The city has announced that chip seal road maintenance begins on September 23, affecting areas like Cross Country Road and the Liberty Business Park, so please drive carefully in those work zones. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing several development projects for their October 5 meeting, including new site plans at the Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do this weekend with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival happening today and the Dane County Farmers' Market also open today. Tomorrow, you can head to Badger Prairie County Park to support a great cause at the Bike the Barns fundraiser.
In a report regarding incidents from late August through mid September, on September 3, a Madison man was arrested for an O W I offence after crashing his vehicle on Shooting Star Road.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10:30 PM today, though please be aware that the restaurant is closed today for a building remodel.
